title: Constellation user-defined tradition (v1)
description: Declarative spec for a user-authored scholarly tradition. Drop one of these JSON files at `<Universe>/.constellation/traditions/<id>.json`. On Sight open, valid files are loaded into the chip dropdown alongside the curated baselines. The JSON Schema fields here are the v1 contract; future versions will be additive (introduced as v2, v3 schemas alongside v1, preserving older files). NOTE on label strings (`name`, `tooltip`, `scope`, every `label` field, `gradient.centerLabel`, `gradient.edgeLabel`): these render as literal text via the i18n `$t(key)` resolver and fall through the active-locale → en → raw-key fallback chain. Plain labels (e.g. `"my-sector"`, `"Phase 1"`) pass through unchanged. AVOID labels that look like dotted i18n key paths (`"app.name"`, `"sight.v6.stratum.foundation"`) — they will accidentally resolve to a translated string from Constellation's own key namespace instead of rendering as the literal you wrote. (Advisory from MIG-026 §μ migration-path audit.)

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 is the only version Constellation 0.3.x recognizes. A mismatched version causes the file to be skipped with a console warning.

id.description: Stable identifier for the tradition. MUST start with `user-` prefix to namespace away from curated tradition ids. Letters, digits, and hyphens only.

name.description: Display label for the chip. 1–60 characters.

shape.description: Geometric shape for the anchor dome. v1 supports 4 declarative shapes. Other shapes (grid, ladder, relational, cyclic-flow, binary-flow) require more complex layout math and are intended for the κ.2 TS plugin loader.

family.description: Family group for the chip dropdown. Defaults to 'user-defined' if omitted. Existing family ids: western-classical, indian-nyaya, sunni-islamic-usul, arabic-islamic-beyond, modern-western, jewish-abrahamic, east-asian-confucian, chinese-pragmatist, african-philosophical, latin-decolonial.

tooltip.description: Hover tooltip in the chip dropdown. Plain text, up to 240 characters.

scope.description: Scope strip below the tradition name in the chip dropdown. Plain text, up to 240 characters. Should describe when to use vs. not use this tradition.

sectorDividers.description: For shape='sectoral'. Array of sectors with angular extent (degrees, 0=east, increases clockwise) + label. Stars are hash-bucketed across sectors deterministically (per-note frontmatter opt-in is a future enhancement).

rings.description: For shape='rings'. Array of concentric ring zones with inner/outer fractions of the dome radius (0..1) + label. Stars are hash-bucketed across rings.

horizontalBands.description: For shape='horizontal-bands'. Array of band labels (top to bottom). Stars are hash-bucketed across bands.

gradient.description: For shape='gradient'. Radial opacity overlay (Polanyi pattern). Identity remap — stars stay at Aristotelian positions; visibility modulates by radial position.

citation.description: Optional Chicago-style scholarly citation, shown at the bottom of the chip's ⓘ disclosure modal. Plain text, multiple lines OK.
